# LastWarZone.com

> The ultimate Last War: Survival Game strategy guide — bilingual EN/VI

## About
LastWarZone is a free, community-driven strategy guide for Last War: Survival Game (by FunFly PTE. LTD.). We cover hero tier lists, combat mechanics, gear systems, and base progression. Updated for Season 3+ meta.

## Key Facts
- Last War has 114M+ total downloads and 3.8M monthly active users (Sept 2026)
- Top markets: US (30-35%), Japan (15-20%), Korea (10-12%), Vietnam (est. 50-150K MAU)
- The damage formula: Damage = Base × 4000/(Defense+4000)
- Effective HP formula: EHP = HP × (Defense+4000)/4000
- Mono-squad (5 same type) grants +20% HP/ATK/DEF bonus
- Type triangle: Aircraft > Tank > Missile > Aircraft (+20% damage bonus)
- Damage Reduction has a 75% hard cap
- Kimberly is the #1 ranked hero across all community tier lists
- Exclusive Weapon Level 20 grants +7.5% squad-wide HP/ATK/DEF
- 10 Mythic (Red) Blueprints required per Mythic gear piece
- Mythic Radar passive: -30% incoming Critical Hit Damage

## Site Structure
- /en/ — English guides and strategy content
- /vi/ — Vietnamese guides (Hướng dẫn tiếng Việt)
- /en/guides/ — All English guide articles
- /vi/guides/ — All Vietnamese guide articles

## Content Categories
- Heroes & Squad Building — Tier lists, hero builds, squad compositions
- Combat Mechanics — Damage formulas, type advantage, formation positioning
- Gear & Equipment — Mythic gear, Exclusive Weapons, upgrade paths
- Base Development — HQ progression, Tech Centre, building priority
- Resources — Gem economy, pack tier lists, VIP optimization
- Seasons & Events — Season meta, SvS strategy, event guides
- Decorations — Decoration tier list, buff guide

## Languages
- English (en)
- Vietnamese (vi)
